purpose: Adapt the first map of each current spine sequence. Learn which museum capacities survive in the Void, which need an adapter, and which need a new construction. An opening trial does not approve every later map.
rules: Name one encounter and one observable consequence before placing objects.
Keep the existing artifact operation. Adapt its placement, supports, input connections and lifecycle only when evidence requires it.
Retain the fixed floor, pillars, shafts and shared desktop/XR player. Protect arrival, readable approach and descent.
Keep tutorial.md and final.md as distinct sources. Record spatial references that will need revision; do not rewrite them as a side effect of placement.
Run the interaction, leave and return, reset, and save/reload the edited placement. A scene loading or a screenshot is not an interaction test.
Record a reusable capacity only with its scope and evidence. Keep native automated, desktop observed and physical headset checks separate.
Preserve original inputs or records when the lesson compares a changed result. Do not silently promise persistence that the artifact does not provide.
Treat first maps as probes. Record later-map exceptions; change the adaptation plan when the evidence changes.

capabilities.name: Editable placement
capabilities.scope: Shared rooms.json, named instances and parts, prefab props, autosave and real model exports.
capabilities.limit: Each new artifact still needs export, bounds and save/reload checks.

capabilities.name: Shared desktop / VR interaction
capabilities.scope: Museum rig, desktop hand adapter, pickup/release, buttons and earned catalyst.
capabilities.limit: A legacy artifact may use a different player group, pointer or global input.

capabilities.name: Retained learner material
capabilities.scope: Trace positions are shared with Grid on the Trace floor.
capabilities.limit: Other seeds, simulation states, meshes and recordings need explicit retention contracts.

capabilities.name: Objects provide local light
capabilities.scope: Carried point, line, trace and triangle lighting; shared evening environment.
capabilities.limit: Do not give every instance a live light. Colour comparisons need controlled illumination.

capabilities.name: Bodies, collision and response
capabilities.scope: Pickable rigid bodies, floor collision, fall damage, safe landing pads and crawler.
capabilities.limit: Moving supports, soft-body contacts and procedural collider updates require separate tests.

capabilities.name: Floor residency and restart
capabilities.scope: Structural window, lazy artifact creation and floor residency.
capabilities.limit: Test global groups, timers, sound, GPU work and state on each imported scene; hidden is not necessarily stopped.

capabilities.name: Controlled comparison
capabilities.scope: Hold an input, change one declared decision, compare two readings.
capabilities.limit: Many museum artifacts have this already; verify it survives relocation and remains readable.

capabilities.name: Live surface / monitor
capabilities.scope: Shader receivers, SubViewports, readable labels and floor surfaces.
capabilities.limit: A static GLB preview does not verify a shader, viewport, simulation or headset rendering.

capabilities.name: Bounded simulation
capabilities.scope: Steps, pause, reset, finite budgets and retained state for dynamic systems.
capabilities.limit: Count actual instances, update work and growth limits; measure the target renderer and headset separately.

capabilities.name: Artifact as architecture
capabilities.scope: Passages, moving platforms, tall forms, rails and paths become part of the construction site.
capabilities.limit: Do not shrink a body-scale lesson to fit. Check clearance, collision and the intended route.

trials.title: A running world
trials.encounter: Arrive beside the existing counter. The count continues while the visitor stands still.
trials.brings: The shared tower and player.
trials.learns: Initialization and per-frame updates; a chosen coordinate origin.
trials.adapt: Use the existing roof as the baseline. Check readable count, safe arrival and a clear first descent.
trials.test: Observe the count increase without input; retry arrival and confirm the world still runs.
trials.carry: A visible point, named frame and familiar player support later constructions.
trials.later: Trace retention, Grid in a shaft and tall column profiles are additional Primitives cases already developed, not properties of this counter.

trials.title: The same cube gains movement
trials.encounter: Meet a still collectible cube, then rise, turn and grow as cumulative demonstrations. Reach a finished pickup.
trials.brings: The familiar cube, local coordinates and the frame clock.
trials.learns: Whole-body transforms, elapsed time, interpolation and filtered overlap signals.
trials.adapt: Bend the long museum route across a floor. Preserve still/translation/rotation/scale comparisons and separate demonstration from collection. Keep a short raised construction route.
trials.test: Translation changes position only; rotation preserves size; pulse preserves proportions. Demonstrations survive contact, a pickup collects once, and both player modes trigger it.
trials.carry: Moving, turning and scaling instances for crossings, arrays and later oscillation.
trials.later: Moving passenger platforms, changing room scale and body-driven openings need additional trials.

trials.title: An address survives an absence
trials.encounter: Collect one cube from 32 addresses, then from a 7 x 7 grid. Grip a miniature selector to choose the same index in a shaft grid; write zero or one to change support.
trials.brings: Familiar pickup cubes, carried point and local coordinates.
trials.learns: Stable indices, independent rows, occupancy values, discretisation and shared data at two scales.
trials.adapt: Keep the original collections. Replace the automatic centre deck with a 0.84 m hand grid linked to a 4.76 m support grid in shaft B.
trials.test: Collecting an address does not shift neighbours. Real grip selects matching indices. Trigger and panel change only selected support; occupied-cell restore waits; retry resets local state.
trials.carry: One editable hand-controlled occupancy assembly with per-cell collision and safe restoration.
trials.later: This first-map trial omits the Molnar comparison. 3D traversal, tiling and clocked scores still need their own trials. Native encounter tests do not replace learner-code tests.

trials.title: Colour is a celebration
trials.encounter: Begin with four colour rules, then walk among the original shape alphabets, poses, composed stacks and gallery columns.
trials.brings: Primitive meshes, transforms and indexed references.
trials.learns: RGB, palettes, assignments and independent material resources; familiar shapes become larger colour compositions.
trials.adapt: 23 independent full-size pillars in a 42 by 18 m trial. Raise this trial's canopy three metres for nine metres of headroom; preserve the 7.4 m gallery compositions and a walkable loop around both shafts.
trials.test: Compare all 23 configurations with the source museum. Walk the loop with desktop and XR bodies. Recolour one indexed part without changing geometry or another instance's material; retain editor save/reload and retry.
trials.carry: A palette and a separate rule assigning its values to parts; full-height compositions as reusable placements.
trials.later: Painting, transparent colour, moving light and the separate reference landscape remain distinct adaptation cases.

trials.title: A pattern is not its colour
trials.encounter: Stand on the checker. Hold its pattern, change the palette, then advance one pattern step.
trials.brings: Grid addresses, palette and independent assignments.
trials.learns: Pattern value, colour mapping and phase as separate decisions.
trials.adapt: Make one walkable inset field on intact slab. Keep controls reachable and separate sound start/stop from the visual pattern.
trials.test: HOLD stops the pattern; COLOUR changes its reading; ONE STEP advances it once. The collider stays still. Leaving the floor silences its audio.
trials.carry: A source rule that can be mapped to different receivers.
trials.later: Ribbon paths, pattern transfers and architectural repetition extend beyond the disco.

trials.title: Two samples before a rate
trials.encounter: Compare two positions on the curve. Change the interval and observe the signed difference quotient.
trials.brings: Coordinates, finite intervals and repeated samples.
trials.learns: Finite differences, sample rules and finite sums.
trials.adapt: Give the rate and accumulation benches a common readable approach. Keep supporting exhibits separate from the first operation; the current tutorial labels still declare a proposed focus.
trials.test: One interval change updates the measured rate; reversed intervals retain the expected sign relationship. Change sum resolution without silently changing the function.
trials.carry: A declared sampling rule, error comparison and rate/accumulation distinction.
trials.later: Flow fields and sustained input require a larger spatial trial. Resolve lesson focus before rewriting its text.

trials.title: Two points make a relation
trials.encounter: Move the known points; read displacement, length and direction, then compare addition and projection.
trials.brings: PointBody, the line and local/world coordinates.
trials.learns: Displacement, a zero-length case, addition and signed projection.
trials.adapt: Place three reachable stations in order. Inspect the hall composer before mounting it so its room and repeated stations are not imported twice.
trials.test: Translate both endpoints equally: displacement stays fixed. Coincident endpoints remain finite. Projection plus remainder reconstructs the displacement.
trials.carry: A vector representation ready to become velocity and force.
trials.later: This opening is geometry; force integration, contacts and moving bodies remain separate tests.

trials.title: A local step chooses a direction
trials.encounter: Predict one downhill update, press STEP, then compare starts and stopping reasons.
trials.brings: Finite differences and vectors.
trials.learns: Cost, numerical gradient, step size and explicit stopping conditions.
trials.adapt: Use a reachable landscape bench with room to compare the retained start and result. Keep the displayed surface distinct from walkable terrain.
trials.test: STEP performs one update; RUN respects its update interval; reset restores a reproducible start. Large steps and domain boundaries produce declared outcomes.
trials.carry: An objective, an update rule and a reason to stop.
trials.later: Minimal surfaces and physical settling need different collision and update contracts.

trials.title: A body returns
trials.encounter: Follow the familiar cube through one cycle. Compare amplitude, period and phase before the responding pendulum.
trials.brings: The transformed cube and elapsed seconds.
trials.learns: Periodic motion, amplitude, frequency, period and phase.
trials.adapt: Keep enough clearance to see one complete motion. Separate clock-driven and hand-released examples; do not import the old high-mounted ornaments into the ceiling.
trials.test: A complete period returns the cube to its starting phase; amplitude changes excursion. The pendulum responds to release rather than replaying the cube's clock.
trials.carry: A returning signal and a distinction between prescribed and responding motion.
trials.later: Sound synthesis, summed waves and surfaces add different performance and audio needs.

trials.title: What chance is allowed to do
trials.encounter: Hold a point through a kept path, compare seeded windows, change one draw or mapping, then carry the same question downstairs to the chair studies.
trials.brings: Point, cube, movement, colour assignment and a retained history.
trials.learns: Repeatability needs a seed and a procedure. Uncertainty also needs a declared outcome and probability model.
trials.adapt: Two selectable trial floors: all 12 original Random Definition placements and all nine Random Entropies groups. Shared seed scope stays per floor. Keep the sampler local to its cabinet; adapt the shared mouse grip and original ride. Use 32-metre depth to preserve full-size chair groups.
trials.test: Replay preserves draws; an extra draw breaks the colour match; a mapping change leaves draws intact. Gesture recording, held-object protection, carried locomotion, finite chair models, door controls, chair pickup, floor sleep and retry work through both input adapters.
trials.carry: Recorded source, explicit mapping, stable identities and a declared comparison.
trials.later: Random_Entropies is included as floor 2. The next map is Random_Entropy. Distribution and random-walk maps still need separate trials.

trials.title: Rules, then changing bodies
trials.encounter: First compare a constrained point, admission spacing, independent image/audio and three viewing walls. Descend to the same column driven by a constant, sine or coherent field.
trials.brings: Local coordinates, seeded draws, retained state, arrays, meshes and transformations.
trials.learns: A constraint can keep acting, apply only at admission, accumulate previous values, or change a receiving body. The image, sound and body need separate explanations.
trials.adapt: Two content floors. Preserve all six Noise Types assemblies and all three Noise Columns assemblies. Keep the viewing-wall lanes, corner landing and comparative sightline clear. The trio retains its 2.55-metre recipe; both shafts stay open.
trials.test: Carry and restore points using actual inputs; replay clouds and wall targets; compare audio without changing bars. Freeze the columns while the orb continues. Separate spin, marble and deformation. Test floor sleep, retry and shared editor saves.
trials.carry: Admission versus enforcement; seeded replay; independent sound/image channels; local clocks; a shared deformation recipe driven by different values.
trials.later: Noise One receives one field as relief and colour; Noise Voxel introduces thresholded occupancy. Headset reach and comfort remain a separate review.

trials.title: One rule, two receivers
trials.encounter: Move RADIUS and switch EDGE; the wall and a square on the cube show the same circle rule.
trials.brings: Cube, point control, distance, colour and source/receiver distinction.
trials.learns: fragment, UV, uniforms, distance masks, step and smoothstep.
trials.adapt: Provide a readable receiver and reachable console between pillars. Preserve live shader materials; exported editor meshes are only placement previews.
trials.test: The same uniform changes both receivers. Hard and gradual boundaries differ as intended in the target renderer and both headset eyes.
trials.carry: A spatially evaluated material rule driven by an existing control.
trials.later: Water, displacement, feedback buffers and compute shaders need separate renderer and budget checks.

trials.title: Read the old row, write the next
trials.encounter: Use the black point to select a neighbourhood; predict a cell, then advance one generation.
trials.brings: Addressed arrays, Boolean values and retained records.
trials.learns: Ordered neighbourhoods, an eight-answer rule, synchronous updates and wrapped boundaries.
trials.adapt: Keep the board and history readable from one stance. Inspect the overhead ring for storey clearance. The point selects an address; it must not silently become a painting tool.
trials.test: STEP matches a known Rule 90 row, including the wrap. The prior row stays unchanged and history remains bounded.
trials.carry: Separate old/next state and retained history.
trials.later: Two-dimensional fields and multiple interacting rules need different capacity budgets.

trials.title: One more frame
trials.encounter: Press MORE; another smaller frame appears. Compare a visible opening with an opening the body can pass.
trials.brings: LineSkin, functions, loops and size parameters.
trials.learns: Self-calls, decreasing arguments, stopping conditions and finite budgets.
trials.adapt: Keep a human-scale first frame and clear approach. Bound depth; separate visual nested frames from collidable passage geometry.
trials.test: Each step adds the expected finite construction; zero depth stops. Changing presentation does not bypass the budget; any doorway agrees with collision.
trials.carry: A bounded recursive construction.
trials.later: Branching recursion multiplies instances; the opening's linear depth budget does not cover trees.

trials.title: Keep the sentence, turn its reading
trials.encounter: Rewrite F once, HOLD the result, then move the point through angle choices.
trials.brings: Strings, functions, line construction and bounded repetition.
trials.learns: Axiom, dictionary rules, parallel rewriting and interpretation.
trials.adapt: Put live and held line drawings beside the same reachable controls. Keep the sentence readable without text wrapping concealing its length.
trials.test: NEXT rewrites from the old sentence once. Angle changes keep the sentence fixed; HOLD preserves both sentence and angle. Enforce symbol and geometry budgets.
trials.carry: A retained description separate from its interpretation.
trials.later: Branching stacks, resource-limited growth and mesh grammars add new state and topology.

trials.title: What the score notices
trials.encounter: Keep six candidate bodies; change TARGET and compare their ranking. Add the ring the estimator ignores.
trials.brings: Design records, arrays and separate builders/readers.
trials.learns: Evaluation criteria, stable identity, rank and omitted features.
trials.adapt: Retain the existing six-candidate desk, witness and rule reveal. Keep labels reachable and the comparison in one view.
trials.test: Changing target changes ranking without mutating candidates. The held record stays fixed. The visible ring leaves the declared estimator unchanged.
trials.carry: A builder and a score with different declared scopes.
trials.later: WFC, connected cells and generated worlds require adjacency, topology and bounded generation trials.

trials.title: One point stays while a body yields
trials.encounter: Press the pinned jelly cube with the carried point; vary one response setting.
trials.brings: Point collider, cube construction and retained mesh connections.
trials.learns: SoftBody3D, a pinned reference vertex, stiffness, damping and pressure.
trials.adapt: Anchor the cube in the tower's local frame. Connect its existing console to the intended body on this floor, with enough clearance for deformation.
trials.test: The pin remains at its translated anchor; contact deforms the body. RESET restores settings without claiming to rewind simulation. Leaving pauses expensive work.
trials.carry: A deforming surface with declared solver and boundary conditions.
trials.later: Cloth, fluids and reaction-diffusion have different state, contact and rendering costs.

trials.title: Values produce a boundary
trials.encounter: Walk around the surface; compare its apparent continuity with its triangular construction.
trials.brings: Scalar samples, grids and triangle meshes.
trials.learns: Scalar field, level set and finite sampling.
trials.adapt: Give the specimen a full viewing loop. Declare whether it is display-only or has a physical boundary; do not assume the mesh supplies collision.
trials.test: A sampled field produces a finite mesh at the declared threshold. Rebuild and reset do not accumulate meshes; collision, if promised, matches the result.
trials.carry: A sampled field converted to explicit surface geometry.
trials.later: Sculpting, dynamic topology and collider rebuilding require additional tests. The present opening tutorial needs a separate code-reconstruction review.

trials.title: Three verbs for the same kinds of body
trials.encounter: Compare union, intersection and ordered difference using the existing box-and-sphere displays.
trials.brings: Primitive bodies, local transforms and surface/collision distinction.
trials.learns: Union, intersection and ordered difference.
trials.adapt: Place the three results along a clear approach. Preserve their authored dimensions; do not pretend their different offsets constitute a controlled identical-operands comparison.
trials.test: Confirm each operation and operand order. A deliberately separated intersection can be empty. Test collision only where the encounter promises a passage.
trials.carry: A declared operation over solids.
trials.later: Animated operands and walkable cuts may require rebuild throttling and collider checks.

trials.title: A trace outlives its maker
trials.encounter: Follow moving dots and the shared trail they read and leave behind.
trials.brings: Point, local samples, separate update phases and retained fields.
trials.learns: Local sensing, steering, deposition and retention feedback.
trials.adapt: Bound the field and make the trail visible on a dark receiver. Keep its controls local to this floor; do not use the physical shaft as the simulation boundary.
trials.test: A repeated start gives the same comparison. Deposit persists after a point moves; retention changes its duration. Population and field memory stay bounded.
trials.carry: A shared environmental record affecting later motion.
trials.later: Flocks, collision avoidance and large populations need different agent and performance checks.

trials.title: Same connections, different visit order
trials.encounter: Watch Two Travellers: breadth-first spreads through a layer; depth-first follows a branch.
trials.brings: Points, arrays, conditions and retained identity.
trials.learns: Vertex IDs, adjacency, queues, stacks and visited state.
trials.adapt: Put the lamp graph in one readable view and keep its playback controls reachable. The bridge model remains a supporting encounter.
trials.test: Both procedures visit every reachable vertex once, in their declared order, without changing the graph. Reset repeats the comparison.
trials.carry: Connections and a traversal procedure separate from geometry.
trials.later: Costs, heuristic search, dynamic graphs and matching add different contracts.

trials.title: Conditions of survival
trials.encounter: Observe bodies sharing resources; compare a repeated start with one changed condition.
trials.brings: Population records, graphs, seeded comparison and fixed updates.
trials.learns: Inherited variation, reproduction, death and resource conditions without ranking every body.
trials.adapt: Use a bounded arena and readable population record. Keep comparative sculptures distinct from the active model. Verify which installed exhibit matches the tutorial focus.
trials.test: Repeat the seed and fixed steps; compare records. Change one resource condition, enforce population limits, and verify streamed-out work stops.
trials.carry: A declared model and retained evidence for comparison.
trials.later: Optimisation, fitting, taught poses and hand-data retention are not established by this evolutionary opening.

trials.title: What the construction assumes
trials.encounter: Return to points, lines and a triangle. Separate a declared postulate from measured angles.
trials.brings: PointBody, finite lines and a three-vertex face.
trials.learns: A parallel through a point, angle measurement, degeneracy and proof versus observation.
trials.adapt: Keep the plaque beside the constructions. Flag the old fixed 60-degree labels; the tutorial's measured reconstruction is a different source of evidence.
trials.test: A nondegenerate planar triangle's measured angles sum within tolerance; a collinear case is identified. A text button does not change the geometry.
trials.carry: An explicit assumption and a measured result with a stated scope.
trials.later: Alternative geometries and logical limits cannot be validated by this planar measurement alone.

trials.title: Different inputs, the same total
trials.encounter: Move a rail, KEEP the arrangement, then seek another with the same displayed result.
trials.brings: Point control, arrays, copied records and a comparison bench.
trials.learns: Weighted expressions, retained inputs, assertions and model limits.
trials.adapt: Rehouse the existing workbench and its local controls. Keep all input readings available alongside the total.
trials.test: The total agrees with the declared expression; KEEP copies the inputs. A changed arrangement can retain the same total. No physical entropy claim follows from that equality.
trials.carry: A stated model, a retained witness and an explicit limit on interpretation.
trials.later: Other QFEP models need their own operational definitions and evidence.

trials.title: Room for a distinction
trials.encounter: Move COMPRESSION; the same authored labels keep their identities while their spatial separation changes.
trials.brings: Point handle, interpolation, arrays and explicit model scope.
trials.learns: Authored interpolation, stable identities and measurement versus interpretation.
trials.adapt: Keep the labelled arrangement legible from both sides. Preserve space for compression and expansion; retain the wider reflective comparisons.
trials.test: Endpoints match the authored arrangements; intermediate positions follow the interpolation; identities stay fixed. Record geometric separation without presenting it as a social measurement.
trials.carry: A revisable construction whose technical and interpretive claims remain distinct.
trials.later: The remaining critical encounters differ in purpose; this one layout rule cannot stand in for their political or material claims.
